# form.addSourceField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Add a source field to the current form.

```lua
form.addSourceField(line, rect, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current value |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on value change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua
local function configure(widget)
  local line = form.addLine("Source")
  form.addSourceField(line, nil,
    function() return widget.source end,
    function(value) widget.source = value end)
end

local function write(widget) storage.write("source", widget.source) end
local function read(widget) widget.source = storage.read("source") end
```

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addSourceField(line, nil, function() return source end, function(newValue) source = newValue end)
```
